verdict.rationale: Netlify provides PR-based deploy previews with dedicated preview URLs and environments (netlify-docs-1, netlify-docs-19), and Netlify Database explicitly supports 'safely iterate' on managed Postgres separate from production (netlify-docs-13), plus new projects stay private until published (netlify-docs-4). These collectively support a sandbox-like preview/staging workflow, but there's no explicit evidence of an AI-agent-specific test/sandbox mode or guaranteed production-data isolation for AI workflows. Missing for 10: explicit AI-agent sandbox testing framework, guaranteed data isolation between preview and production databases, and independent confirmation that preview environments never touch production data.
